s: The unit concerns TRACE, a retrieval-augmented generation approach for improving multi-hop question answering. It addresses noise caused by imperfect retrievers by constructing knowledge-grounded reasoning chains from retrieved documents. TRACE uses a Knowledge Graph Generator to create a knowledge graph and an Autoregressive Reasoning Chain Constructor to build logically connected chains of knowledge triples. On three multi-hop QA datasets, TRACE improved average performance by up to 14.03% compared with using all retrieved documents, and reasoning chains were often sufficient as context for correct answers.

s: The unit concerns retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) models and TRACE, a method for improving their performance on multi-hop question answering (QA).
